title: fixture-primitives-move-down-a-rung
intention: The proof fixture primitives in cairn/devices/tester/scratch.py (scratch_dir, scratch_worktree, git_env) move down a rung to a tool, cairn/tools/scratch/, whose charter declares public_interface ['cairn.tools.scratch.scratch'], so every proof in every component reaches them through a declared tool interface instead of into the tester device.
why: RULE 1 child 3: fixture primitives move down a rung to a tool
traces_to: RULE 1 (Akien, 2026-10-01: every component talks to every other only through its public interface; a device's is the bus plus any client tool it publishes) — the fixture primitives are not the tester's interface, they are a tool everyone uses; Law 6 (a tool has users, not an owner); parent 8e3474a6ae43.
how: Measured 2026-10-02 (encapsulation_breaches over the live repo): 90 into_device rows land on cairn.devices.tester.scratch, plus 1 on cairn.devices.tester.scratch_sweep (that one is the db sweep and stays in tester). scratch.py is 218 lines and imports only the standard library (atexit, shutil, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib), so nothing in it depends on the device: it is a tool by Law 6's test (no state of its own to gate). Import shapes: `from cairn.devices.tester.scratch import scratch_dir` (98, with trailing comments) and `... import scratch_worktree` (3). Inside tester, cli.py, device.py, reseal.py and hollow.py import it too. String uses that run as code: tester/proofs/test_hollow.py:318 and :627 (subprocess bodies) and tester/proofs/test_scratch.py (fixture bodies and the corpus tooth's message at :167). The tester's own history.json note (hollow voyage) already records 'git_env lives in cairn.devices.tester.scratch, so build_inspector's and ruling's proofs cannot import it without a cross-device import ... Its right home is a tool.' Plan: git mv cairn/devices/tester/scratch.py to cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py and cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_scratch.py to cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py, add __init__.py, write the tool's charter through the artifact door, rewrite every `cairn.devices.tester.scratch` dotted path (import lines, subprocess bodies, comments) to `cairn.tools.scratch.scratch` across .py files and bin/, reseal test_scratch at its new address, and retire the old tester/validations/test_scratch.json through the validation door.
falsifier: RED if: (1) the live encapsulation_breaches carries any row whose module is cairn.devices.tester.scratch; (2) any .py file or bin/ command names cairn.devices.tester.scratch, or cairn/devices/tester/scratch.py exists; (3) cairn/tools/scratch/intention+why.json does not declare public_interface exactly ['cairn.tools.scratch.scratch'], or that module does not expose scratch_dir, scratch_worktree and git_env, or cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py does not exit 0. WRONG INTENT if scratch.py turns out to hold tester-only state that a tool cannot carry. Horizon: the tester seal of cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py and of the new tooth proof.
watchme: none, because the encapsulation_holds sieve (ticket 56d1aff4455e, proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_encapsulation_holds.py) reads the live repo on every inspector run; a proof reaching back into the tester for scratch reds there the moment it is written, so no runtime behaviour is left for a probe to watch
children: none, because the edits are two git mv, one new charter, one proof, and a dotted-path rewrite in each importer
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which files? every file under cairn/ and bin/ naming cairn.devices.tester.scratch outside history.json and validations/ — replace the dotted path with cairn.tools.scratch.scratch, keep everything else on the line. (2) The moves? git mv cairn/devices/tester/scratch.py cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py; git mv cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_scratch.py cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py; empty __init__.py in cairn/tools/scratch/. (3) The charter? cairn/tools/scratch/intention+why.json through cairn artifact write --verb charter, node_class tool, public_interface ['cairn.tools.scratch.scratch']. (4) Proof? cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch_is_a_tool.py, three teeth, one per falsifier clause, red first.

chart_claim.filled_by: CC chart chain (orient 4a4b40b2c0c1 .. validate 6f1fbaca0bb7, each learned)

decisions.text: STEP 1 — the proof, already written red at cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch_is_a_tool.py (do not rewrite it). Teeth, PROVES keys 1/2/3: (1) nothing_reaches_into_the_tester_for_scratch — no row of cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector.encapsulation_breaches(repo) has module 'cairn.devices.tester.scratch'; (2) the_old_address_is_gone — no .py file anywhere in the repo (outside .git, __pycache__ and the proof itself) and no file under bin/ (suffix '', .py, .sh) contains the dotted path cairn.devices.tester.scratch not followed by a word character (so cairn.devices.tester.scratch_sweep is allowed), and cairn/devices/tester/scratch.py does not exist; (3) the_tool_stands — cairn/tools/scratch/intention+why.json has public_interface exactly ['cairn.tools.scratch.scratch'], that module exposes scratch_dir, scratch_worktree, git_env, and python3 cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py exits 0. Red now: 0/3 (101 files name the old path).

STEP 2 — the moves: mkdir -p cairn/tools/scratch/proofs; create empty cairn/tools/scratch/__init__.py; git mv cairn/devices/tester/scratch.py cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py; git mv cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_scratch.py cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py. Both files sit at the same depth below the repo root (parents[4]) at old and new address, so REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] in test_scratch.py stays right. cairn/devices/tester/scratch_sweep.py does NOT move (it is the tester's db sweep).

STEP 3 — the rewrite: in every .py file in the repo (outside .git and the proof test_scratch_is_a_tool.py) and every non-.json file under bin/, replace the regex cairn\.devices\.tester\.scratch(?!\w) with cairn.tools.scratch.scratch (perl -pi). This covers import lines, the subprocess bodies in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py (lines ~318 and ~627) and in test_scratch.py, and comments. history.json files and validations/ are records and are not touched. In the moved test_scratch.py also replace the worktree path check ('cairn' / 'devices' / 'tester' / 'scratch.py') with ('cairn' / 'tools' / 'scratch' / 'scratch.py'), and its docstring's own path cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_scratch.py with cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py. Inside the tester, cli.py, device.py, reseal.py and hollow.py import the tool like every other caller.

STEP 4 — the charter, through cairn artifact write /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/scratch/intention+why.json --verb charter --why '9245b9cbce53 ...' --from <file>: component 'scratch', runtime_role/node_class 'tool', public_interface ['cairn.tools.scratch.scratch'] (no published_by_device — it is not inside a device), what (scratch_dir, scratch_worktree, git_env), why (the 2026-08-03 leak measurement; moved because RULE 1 forbids 90 proofs reaching into the tester and these touch no tester state), entry (GRAFTED by git mv), invoke, state_and_history (a tool holds no state of its own), proof (both proofs), gates (encapsulation_holds), falsifier, learns and how_it_learns (one answer, same text: it does not; fixed primitive), traces_to, owner (none — a tool has users), gated_by ['CC'].

STEP 5 — verify and seal: python3 cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch_is_a_tool.py exits 0 (3/3); cairn test <proof> --netns --seal for both cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py and test_scratch_is_a_tool.py, sealing into cairn/tools/scratch/validations/; the old cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_scratch.json names a proof that no longer exists and is removed with git rm in the same commit (its successor is the seal at the new address); the commit's reseal door reproves standing proofs whose sealed inputs named the moved scratch.py; then cairn test --hollow 9245b9cbce53 --seal.
